description: The pie chart depicts the domain distribution of the AttrEval-GenSearch test set, representing twelve categories. The chart includes a legend listing each category alongside its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The largest slice, labeled “AI/NLP Research,” is colored blue and represents approximately 24.3% of the total. “Econ. & Fin.” is the next largest, colored red and accounting for 18.4%. Following these, slices are present for “History” (8.2%, orange), “Game&Anime” (8.2%, light teal), “Daily Life” (7.1%, dark teal), “Med & Health” (6.7%, yellow), “Science” (6.7%, light blue), “Business” (5.9%, dark blue), “Pet & Animal” (5.5%, pink), “Law” (5.1%, purple), “Geography” (2.7%, green), and “Math” (1.2%, brown). The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, encompassing twelve distinct categories. The largest category, 'AI/NLP Research,' accounts for approximately 24.3% of the dataset, followed by 'Econ. & Fin.' at 18.4%. 'History' and 'Game&Anime' are tied at 8.2%, while 'Daily Life' constitutes 7.1%. 'Med & Health' and 'Science' both represent 6.7%, with 'Business' slightly lower at 5.9%. 'Pet & Animal' and 'Law' are close in proportion, at 5.5% and 5.1%, respectively. 'Geography' and 'Math' are the smallest categories, with 'Geography' at 3.7% and 'Math' at 2.2%. Notably, 'Daily Life' has shown a consistent increase in representation compared to previous datasets, while 'Geography' has seen a slight decline.
